subject: Miranda Briseño Candidate Profile
overview: Miranda Briseño introduced her candidacy for the Medford City Council, sharing her platform on housing affordability, school funding, public safety, and transportation.

items.title: Candidate Statement of Miranda Briseño
items.summary: Miranda Briseño outlined her platform for City Council, focusing on increased school funding, affordable housing options for renters and seniors, and leveraging her professional experience as a MassDOT transportation planner to improve Medford's road safety and infrastructure.
